romans.2.p1.b1.text: You, therefore, have no excuse, you who pass judgment on another.

romans.2.p1.b2.text: For on whatever grounds you judge the other, you are condemning yourself, …

romans.2.p1.b3.text: So when you, O man, pass judgment on others, yet do the same things, do you think you will escape God’s judgment?

romans.2.p1.b4.text: … not realizing that God’s kindness leads you to repentance?

romans.2.p2.b1.text: God “will repay each one according to his deeds.”

romans.2.p2.b2.text: but glory, honor, and peace for everyone who does good, first for the Jew, then for the Greek.

romans.2.p2.b3.text: For God does not show favoritism.

romans.2.p3.b1.text: For it is not the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but it is the doers of the law who will be declared righteous.

romans.2.p3.b2.text: Indeed, when Gentiles, who do not have the law, do by nature what the law requires, …

romans.2.p3.b3.text: … they show that the work of the law is written on their hearts, …

romans.2.p3.b4.text: on the day when God will judge men’s secrets through Christ Jesus, as proclaimed by my gospel.

romans.2.p4.b1.text: Now you, if you call yourself a Jew; if you rely on the law and boast in God;

romans.2.p4.b2.text: if you are convinced that you are a guide for the blind, a light for those in darkness,

romans.2.p4.b3.text: … because you have in the law the embodiment of knowledge and truth

romans.2.p5.b1.text: you, then, who teach others, do you not teach yourself?

romans.2.p5.b2.text: You who preach against stealing, do you steal?

romans.2.p5.b3.text: You who boast in the law, do you dishonor God by breaking the law?

romans.2.p5.b4.text: … “God’s name is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you.”

romans.2.p6.b1.text: Circumcision has value if you observe the law, but if you break the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

romans.2.p6.b2.text: If a man who is not circumcised keeps the requirements of the law, will not his uncircumcision be regarded as circumcision?

romans.2.p6.b3.text: … will condemn you who, even though you have the written code and circumcision, are a lawbreaker.

romans.2.p7.b1.text: A man is not a Jew because he is one outwardly, nor is circumcision only outward and physical.

romans.2.p7.b2.text: No, a man is a Jew because he is one inwardly, and circumcision is a matter of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the written code.

romans.2.p7.b3.text: Such a man’s praise does not come from men, but from God.
